verdict.rationale: Ente Auth does not document a region picker for its hosted cloud. It does let users control where their data lives in two first-party ways: pointing the apps at a self-hosted Ente server, or using offline mode so codes stay only on the device (with a custom local backup location). missing for 10: documented region/residency selection for Ente's hosted sync service, any statement of where hosted data is stored, independent corroboration of self-hosted Auth residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Alternatively, if using Ente Auth, get started by adding an account (assuming you are running Ente Auth at `http://<machine-ip>:3003` or `http://localhost:3003`).
In offline mode, your codes are stored only on that device.
Custom backup location: Choose where to store your backups on your device.
